<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"siainbuletin"} -->
_Requested by **Sia** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01KaQfLZaF43QUMN3kcT7pW2?thread=cmsg_01KaQfLZaF43QUMN3kcT7pW2WBxsjpG5v1LFDtrBCVk8Bg)_

Before: `sp-vcontrol` only set up Magit and the `yadm` command.

After: it also loads `forge` after `magit` and sets `auth-sources` to `~/.authinfo` (Sia's commit, kept as is). The literate doc `docs/tangles/prog/sp-vcontrol.org` now documents the Forge part and the new header comments, and `CHANGELOG.org` has an entry.

How: the first commit is Sia's `sp-vcontrol.el`, copied from their machine (it was not pushed). The second updates the doc to match the code; the tangled `.el` is unchanged from Sia's version.

Not tested: Forge is not installed in the container and I could not run Emacs, so neither the Forge config nor re-tangling the doc was checked. Please tangle and try `M-x forge-pull` on your machine.

---
